divergences.summary: Keep original rule state, geometry and specificity within a zero-specificity editor scope and repository cascade layers. Distinct custom properties are renamed consistently across producers and consumers.

The existing Proctor notification renderer measures actual row DOM. Restore the upstream shared density setter/event/constants, use that metric as the measured row minimum, and remeasure active lists on changes.

verification.obligation: Verify the source mechanism and explicit product seams; production integration and complete specification review are separate mandatory acceptance gates.
